g1.flow: Al-Ḥāqqah and Al-Māʿūn say wa-lā yaḥuḍḍu ('he does not encourage'). Al-Fajr alone says wa-lā taḥāḍḍūna ('you do not encourage one another'), because the ayat around it speak to 'you': you do not honor the orphan, you consume inheritance. Al-Māʿūn also has an orphan just before, but there it is 'the one who drives away', one person, so yaḥuḍḍu.

cues.69:34: Wa-lā yaḥuḍḍu, about 'he': after he did not believe in Allāh, the Most Great.
cues.89:18: Wa-lā taḥāḍḍūna: between 'you do not honor the orphan' and 'you consume inheritance'.
cues.107:3: Wa-lā yaḥuḍḍu: after 'the one who drives away the orphan'; next, woe to those who pray.
